about: chi2(mu, width) of the 45-bin Gaussian+line fit, minimised over n_sig and the line at each node (profile). z holds chi2 - chi2min, row-major: z[j*nx + i] at x[i] = mu, y[j] = width (MeV/c^2). path is the logged Levenberg-Marquardt iterations of d0-fit.json as [mu, width, profile dchi2, dchi2 of the iterate itself]; the ball rides the profile surface. contours are closed polylines [mu, width] at dchi2 = 1 and 4. slice: chi2 - chi2min against mu with the width also profiled; its dchi2 = 1 crossings are the mu error.

pdgOnSlice.about: chi2 - chi2min on the 1D slice in mu (width profiled too) at PDG 2026's 1864.84 and its edges 1864.80 / 1864.88, each minimised afresh (not read off the slice grid). sqrt(dchi2) is how many of our statistical errors each value lies from the fitted mu. interp: linear on the slice grid.
